data.content_ref: inline:On each refutation, rewrite the graph structurally: replace the refuting subgraph with a single canonical 'defeater' node whose outgoing attacks are the union of the refuting subgraph's attacks, and define the grounded extension over the fully normalized graph. Unlike RESIDUE (SRC_005), which annotates the final labeling, this carries the reason a node stays OUT in the graph shape itself, so reinstatement still emerges from the fixed point over the normalized graph. Criticizable points: confluence of the rewrite under arbitrary refutation orderings is unproven, and the rewrite changes the graph that later edge-construction passes (SRC_002) see, so interaction with fresh-warrant re-examination (SRC_006) is underspecified.
